title: Define reporting policy and thresholds
description:
Goal:
- Agree on report cadence (daily/weekly/monthly), time window, and timezone
- Define what "too much hours" means (global threshold or per profile/role)
- Confirm recipients: project leads and company stakeholders
- Clarify cost calculation rules (current rate vs rate at time of entry)

Acceptance:
- Decisions captured and shared with the team
- Chosen defaults documented for implementation

title: Add user profiles with hourly cost rates
description:
Goal:
- Create a Profile entity (name, discipline, level, costPerHour, active)
- Add relation from User to Profile
- Create migrations and seed default profiles (backend junior, backend mid, frontend junior, UX junior, UX mid, etc.)

Acceptance:
- Profiles can be created and assigned in the database
- Existing users have a valid profile after migration

title: Add project budget fields and currency support
description:
Goal:
- Add budget fields to Project (budgetAmount, currency)
- Define default currency and validation rules
- Add migrations and backfill defaults

Acceptance:
- Projects store a budget and currency
- Validation prevents negative or invalid budget values

title: Expose profile and budget APIs
description:
Goal:
- Implement CRUD endpoints for profiles (admin-only)
- Add endpoints to assign profiles to users
- Add endpoints to update project budgets
- Validate input with DTOs and class-validator

Acceptance:
- Admin can manage profiles, user assignments, and budgets via API
- Requests are validated and errors are descriptive

title: Compute cost of time entries
description:
Goal:
- Calculate cost using hours * profile costPerHour
- Decide whether to store a cost snapshot per entry or compute at query time
- Backfill costs for existing entries if needed

Acceptance:
- Cost is available per entry and for rollups
- Changes in profile rates have a clear, consistent effect

title: Admin UI for profiles, assignments, and project budgets
description:
Goal:
- Add screens to list/create/edit profiles
- Add user profile assignment UI
- Add project budget editing UI

Acceptance:
- Admin can manage profiles, user assignments, and budgets from the UI
- Forms include validation and error handling

title: Configure stakeholder recipients for company reports
description:
Goal:
- Create a StakeholderRecipient model (email, active, name/label)
- Add CRUD endpoints (admin-only)
- Add admin UI to manage recipients

Acceptance:
- Admin can configure who receives company-wide reports
- Recipients are stored and retrievable

title: Project lead report aggregation service
description:
Goal:
- Aggregate team hours by project lead for a time window
- Identify team members exceeding the hours threshold
- Include cost summary per project if available

Acceptance:
- Service returns a complete report payload per project lead
- Over-limit members are clearly flagged

title: Company-wide report aggregation service
description:
Goal:
- Aggregate total hours and costs across all projects
- Compare cost to project budgets (over/under)
- Provide summary totals and top-level breakdowns

Acceptance:
- Service returns a single company report payload
- Budget variance is calculated and displayed

title: Email templates for project lead and company reports
description:
Goal:
- Create email templates (HTML + text) for project lead reports
- Create email templates for company-wide reports
- Ensure templates are localized/timezone aware if needed

Acceptance:
- Emails render correctly with real data
- Templates include warnings for over-hours cases

title: BullMQ queues and workers for report jobs
description:
Goal:
- Define BullMQ queues for project lead reports and company reports
- Implement worker processors in worker_app
- Ensure jobs are idempotent and retry-safe

Acceptance:
- Jobs can be enqueued and processed successfully
- Failures are retried and logged

title: Scheduling and manual triggers for report jobs
description:
Goal:
- Configure repeatable jobs (cron) for each report type
- Add an admin-only endpoint to trigger jobs manually
- Store schedule settings in config or database

Acceptance:
- Reports run on schedule and can be triggered on demand
- Schedules can be changed without code changes

title: Report delivery logging and audit trail
description:
Goal:
- Store report run metadata (run time, status, recipients, errors)
- Expose admin-only endpoint to view recent runs

Acceptance:
- Each report run is tracked
- Failures include enough detail for debugging

title: Access control and permissions for reporting features
description:
Goal:
- Ensure only admins manage profiles, budgets, and recipients
- Ensure project leads only receive data for their projects
- Review endpoints and UI for least-privilege access

Acceptance:
- Unauthorized actions are blocked
- Permissions are tested for key endpoints

title: Tests for cost calculation and reporting
description:
Goal:
- Unit tests for cost calculation and threshold logic
- Integration tests for report aggregation
- Worker job tests for BullMQ processors

Acceptance:
- Key logic is covered by automated tests
- Critical paths have regression coverage

title: Documentation for report setup and operations
description:
Goal:
- Document required env vars (email, queue, schedules)
- Add runbook for triggering reports and reading logs
- Describe how cost is calculated and budget variance is derived

Acceptance:
- README or ops docs include clear setup steps
- Onboarding notes explain reporting behavior
